name: Snyk VulnBench 2.0
question: What do AI security agents find that SAST does not, and what do they miss that SAST catches?
summary: A blind study of nine productized security configurations, from the Snyk Code static analyzer to Claude Code, Codex Security and DeepSec, on 108 hand-curated, attacker-reachable vulnerabilities in 20 open-source web applications.
catalogue_footer: Each release defines its own protocol, reference set, metrics and dataset version. Numbers are never compared across releases.
